hints.title: Inverse State Formulation
hints.text: Invert the state: compute the maximum number of floors that can be tested given m moves and k eggs.

hints.title: Floor Coverage Transition
hints.text: With m moves and e eggs, dropping an egg partitions floors into broken and unbroken outcomes: dp[m][e] equals dp[m-1][e-1] plus dp[m-1][e] plus one.

hints.title: Target Floor Reached Condition
hints.text: Increment the move count m until the maximum testable floors with k eggs is at least n, then return m.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: M: minimal moves (at most N, typically O(log N))
complexity.notes: 1D space inverted formulation computing max testable floors per move.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Classic O(K * N^2) floor-by-floor search times out for N = 10000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D table of size K + 1 consumes O(K) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Invert the problem to moves-as-index to achieve O(K log N) time complexity.
